units.source_text: 对于干这种行当的女人，我是头一回感到她的美。

en.t: For the first time, I felt beauty in a woman of that profession.

units.source_text: 并不是因为她像有为子。

en.t: It was not because she resembled Uiko.

units.source_text: 她仿佛是一幅经过逐一推敲吟咏而描绘出来的肖像，刻意画得不像有为子。

en.t: She seemed like a portrait painted after each detail had been carefully pondered and savored, deliberately made not to resemble Uiko.

units.source_text: 它是抗拒有为子的记忆而形成的影像，带有一种反抗式的新鲜的美。

en.t: It was an image formed in resistance to the memory of Uiko, bearing a fresh beauty that felt defiant.

units.source_text: 之所以这么说，是因为她带有一种媚态，这种媚态是对于我有生以来最初感受的美所产生的一种滞后的官能的反抗。

en.t: I say this because she had a certain coquetry, and that coquetry was a delayed, sensual rebellion against the first beauty I had ever felt in my life.
